target_users: Solo freelance makeup artists and bridal stylists
Small salon owners with 1 to 3 assistants
Makeup artists who manage client bookings via WhatsApp and Instagram
one_line_summary: a mobile app build for mua
core_capabilities: Create invoices in 3 taps with client name, event date, total fee, and advance paid
Track pending balances and mark payments as received
Generate one-click polite WhatsApp payment reminders ready to copy and send
Show a Who Owes Me dashboard listing overdue clients, exact amounts, and days overdue
Display a 30, 60, and 90 day cash forecast chart comparing expected client inflows against upcoming bills like rent and cosmetic restocks
Provide a What-If scenario toggle to simulate a key bridal client paying 15 days late and see how it impacts cash
Trigger clear action alerts like Chase Priya's balance today to cover next month's rent
Pre-load realistic sample makeup artist data so the app works immediately on open
non_goals: No complex tax or GST filing
No live bank account syncing or payment gateway integration
No multi-branch or enterprise staff permissions
